<reason>A won by making the live clash decidable: adult natives keep full membership after every language or civic skip, so an immigrant-only “adoption” floor is a second standard triggered by origin, not reciprocity. B’s “same bar, different delivery” and silent-enclave points stayed live but were damaged by the child-schooling concession and by never naming a native-adult membership failure. B also paid a real cost for two clipped turns and an overclaimed closing.</reason>
